description: This file defines functions and constants for synthesizing font glyphs in FreeType, specifically for emboldening and slanting glyphs.

methods.name: FT_GlyphSlot_Embolden
methods.description: Embeds a glyph by a reasonable value, wrapping underlying FreeType functions.

methods.name: FT_GlyphSlot_Oblique
methods.description: Slants an outline glyph to the right by about 12 degrees.
